note: Every external dataset the VM analysis uses: official source, how the latest version is found, how a download is verified, what is built from it. tools/sources/dfir_sources.py reads this file; nothing is fetched from anywhere else. Collector-side tools (EZ Tools, Hayabusa/Sigma rules) are in tools/tools_manifest.json and the Builder (task T6).
